en.title: Maximum Total Power of Three-Server Medians with Leftovers Allowed
en.description:
Choose some disjoint triples of servers; each group's power is the median of its three values. Any server may go unused, and building no group at all is also allowed; maximize the sum of the groups' medians.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains the powers. The original text had no numeric bounds; this site uses 1≤n≤200000, −10^9≤power≤10^9; this site includes negative powers, and groups with negative gain need not be built.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 8, 0 and 8. With negative values, building no group gives 0 instead of being forced to build one.
hints: Sort in descending order and examine the 2nd, 4th, … 2⌊n/3⌋-th items in turn, adding only the positive ones.
